metaTitle: P.L.A.W for federations, clubs and academies
metaDescription: The training data of a whole organisation in one place: the head coach's oversight console, side-by-side comparison of players, one shared methodology. The data belongs to the organisation, not to the coach.
title: See how your whole organisation trains
subtitle: Your coaches plan and record practices on court. Your head coach sees in one console how the work actually runs — and the data stays with the organisation even after a coach leaves.

features.title: The data belongs to the organisation
features.description: The players and their entire training history belong to the organisation, not to the coach. When a coach leaves, neither the players nor their records go anywhere — the head coach reassigns them and the work continues where it stopped.

features.title: The head coach's console
features.description: On one screen: how many practices are on today, which players have fallen out of rhythm and which coach is responsible for them. From there you can open a player, a single practice, or the analytics behind it.

features.title: Players side by side
features.description: The same charts your coaches see, for a whole group at once — grouped by coach or by year of birth. You can see where the focus of training diverges, without collecting numbers by hand.

features.title: One shared methodology
features.description: The organisation sets the drill codes once, for all of its coaches. Without that every coach measures in their own way and the numbers cannot be compared across the organisation — this way they can.

features.title: Your own address
features.description: The organisation gets its own address in the form yourclub.plaw.win, with sign-in for its people only. One organisation's data is kept separate from every other.

features.title: A coach with several players
features.description: The coach's app is built for a phone, right on court: the day's schedule across all of their players, switching between them in one tap, and a warning about the one who has gone longest without a practice.

steps.title: The organisation gets its own address
steps.body: We set up the address, create the organisation and agree the number of coach seats. The head coach signs in and the console is ready.

steps.title: The head coach invites the coaches
steps.body: They generate an invitation code and send it to a coach. The coach enters it once in the app and is in the organisation — nobody has to be added on their behalf.

steps.title: The coaches work, the console shows the result
steps.body: A coach plans and records practices as usual. The head coach enters nothing — they see a live overview and the analytics of the whole organisation.

notes: The head coach's overview is read-only — practices are created and edited by the coaches, so nobody overwrites their data and nothing goes missing on them.
The organisation decides how many coach seats it needs, and the number can be increased at any time.
Following practices as a parent or a player is a feature of the standalone product for individual coaches — in organisation mode the training data stays internal.
pricingText: Minimum three coaches. Prices exclude VAT. Pay for the year up front and save up to 30%.
